ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Non PowerShell WSMAN COM Provider
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious use of the WSMAN provider without PowerShell.exe as the host application. Note: Unmapped fields: Data

sequences.query: Data = RGX(".*ProviderName\\=WSMan.*") AND  NOT ((Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\System32\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\SysWOW64\\\\WindowsPowerShell\\\\v1\\\.0\\\\powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\/Windows\\/System32\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*") OR Data = RGX(".*HostApplication\\=C\\:\\/Windows\\/SysWOW64\\/WindowsPowerShell\\/v1\\\.0\\/powershell.*")) OR Data = RGX("HostId=[a-zA-Z0-9-]{36}\s+EngineVersion="))
